=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- docs/plans/replace-claude-sessions-with-cli-engine-plan.md:305-306 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The agents.md retirement map refers to a Claude-fixer paragraph that the reviewer says does not exist in the asserted form and gives an inaccurate section range.
  WHY: Phase 2 may fail to find the paragraph or edit unrelated content, leaving CLAUDE.md/agents.md inconsistent with the retirement map.
- docs/plans/replace-claude-sessions-with-cli-engine-plan.md:305 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The plan refers to `workflow-templates/CLAUDE.md` as a symlink, but the reviewer reports that file does not exist.
  WHY: Phase 2 may skip the cross-reference update, leaving CLAUDE.md references inconsistent between the repository and consumer copies.
- docs/plans/replace-claude-sessions-with-cli-engine-plan.md:508 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Phase 0 flips the `AI_ISSUE_IMPLEMENTER` default while Phase 2 later deletes the routing script, so consumers syncing Phase 0 alone may route issues away from Claude while the Claude routing chain remains installed.
  WHY: This makes the independently mergeable Phase 0 unsafe for consumers and conflicts with the plan's claim that phases can merge in any order.
- docs/plans/replace-claude-sessions-with-cli-engine-plan.md:575-595 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The bulk branch-deletion procedure does not guard against a branch head changing after the saved `ref → sha` list is collected.
  WHY: A concurrent push could be deleted without its new SHA being saved, making the branch unrecoverable through the documented restore mechanism.
- docs/plans/replace-claude-sessions-with-cli-engine-plan.md:565-570 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The Phase 7 “Subsumes” list names P:5053, P:5290, and P:5334 as code paths without identifying whether they are existing issue IDs or placeholders.
  WHY: The Phase 7 implementation may be unable to locate the paths it is meant to subsume.
- docs/plans/replace-claude-sessions-with-cli-engine-plan.md:218-238 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: D2 broadens the existing `ai:codex` label from a routing-only signal to forcing `AI_ENGINE=codex` for every role, changing its behavior for consumers.
  WHY: After Phase 5d changes defaults to Claude, existing uses of `ai:codex` may change behavior across roles without a consumer-side operator step.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Q40 | A | The operator sets `CLAUDE_FIXER_ENABLED=false` on coding-workflows before Phase 0, so this plan's own PRs take the codex autofix and auto-merge path; Phase 5c turns it back on"
  expected_change_site: docs/plans/replace-claude-sessions-with-cli-engine-plan.md Rollout activation gates
  confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The Rollout section (Activation gates 3) says "After 5c merges: set `CLAUDE_FIXER_ENABLED=true` (or delete the variable)", but there is no checklist, runbook entry, or operator reminder mechanism ensuring this is done or verified.
- requirement: "Phase 7 (Unblock judge) subsumes the security-pass bypass paths (P:5053, P:5290, P:5334)"
  expected_change_site: Phase 7 (Unblock judge) implementation; "Subsumes" list
  confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The plan does not identify whether P:5053, P:5290, and P:5334 are existing issue IDs or placeholders, or otherwise specify how to locate the paths.
- requirement: "Phase 7 ... `ai:operator-step` issue writer shared with Phase 8c"
  expected_change_site: A shared `scripts/operator_step_issue_writer.py` (or equivalent) used by both Phase 7's `unblock_judge.sh` and Phase 8c's `activation_verify.sh`
  confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: Phase 7 and Phase 8c describe the shared issue writer, but neither Implementation Steps section enumerates the shared helper file or names the script.

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- docs/plans/replace-claude-sessions-with-cli-engine-plan.md: 305-306 (agents.md retirement map) | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The plan's agents.md "Retire" column lists the section "Interactive post-push PR status check-in (933–1192)" — I verified the heading begins at line 933, but `agents.md` continues to line 1250+, and the heading section closes well past line 1192. The "Rewrite" column for agents.md therefore lists a paragraph that doesn't exist in the form claimed.
  WHY: Phase 2 implementation will search for a Claude-fixer paragraph at "around 80–150" and may not find one in the asserted shape; edits will either be skipped or land at unrelated positions, leaving CLAUDE.md/agents.md in a state inconsistent with the retirement map.
- docs/plans/replace-claude-sessions-with-cli-engine-plan.md: 305 (Retirement map, agents.md row, CLAUDE.md symlink claim) | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The plan's CLAUDE.md row says "and its `workflow-templates/CLAUDE.md` symlink" — but `workflow-templates/CLAUDE.md` does not exist in the repository (I searched).
  WHY: Phase 2 step 6 ("update the cross-references listed in the retirement map") will look for a `workflow-templates/CLAUDE.md` to edit; nothing to find means the cross-reference update is silently skipped on the consumer side, leaving CLAUDE.md cross-references inconsistent between coding-workflows root and consumer copies.
- docs/plans/replace-claude-sessions-with-cli-engine-plan.md: 508 (Phase 0 step 4: `scripts/claude_issue_route.py`) | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Phase 0 edits `scripts/claude_issue_route.py` in a way Phase 2 then deletes, while Phase 0's default flip may reach consumers before the Claude routing machinery is removed.
  WHY: A consumer that syncs only Phase 0 (because it is independently mergeable) loses the ability to route issues to Claude even though the Claude queue / pickup / implementer chain is still installed in their `.claude/` tree; the D1 "any phase safe in any order" property fails for Phase 0 with respect to consumers.
- docs/plans/replace-claude-sessions-with-cli-engine-plan.md: 575-595 (Phase 1 teardown; bulk branch deletion via `git push origin --delete`) | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The branch deletion procedure does not specify a concurrency guard for pushes between the `git ls-remote` listing and `git push origin --delete`.
  WHY: A concurrent push can move a branch after its SHA is saved, and the deletion can remove the new head without saving that SHA for restoration.
- docs/plans/replace-claude-sessions-with-cli-engine-plan.md: 565-570 (Phase 7, "Subsumes" list) | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The “Subsumes” list names P:5053, P:5290, and P:5334 as existing terminals, but the plan does not identify whether these are actual issue IDs or placeholders.
  WHY: Phase 7 implementation will look for the named bypass paths and may not know whether to proceed or ask the operator if nothing matches.
- docs/plans/replace-claude-sessions-with-cli-engine-plan.md: 218-238 (Retired identifiers table; §6 "Section numbers unchanged") | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: D2 broadens the existing `ai:codex` label from a routing-only signal to forcing `AI_ENGINE=codex` for every role.
  WHY: Consumer repos that use `ai:codex` today may see the label change behavior across roles, including after Phase 5d sets defaults to `claude`, without an operator step on the consumer side.
- Requirement: "Q40 | A | The operator sets `CLAUDE_FIXER_ENABLED=false` on coding-workflows before Phase 0, so this plan's own PRs take the codex autofix and auto-merge path; Phase 5c turns it back on"
  Expected change site: docs/plans/replace-claude-sessions-with-cli-engine-plan.md Phase 0 ("the operator sets `CLAUDE_FIXER_ENABLED=false` ... Phase 5c turns it back on") and the Rollout activation gates
  Evidence of absence: The plan's Rollout section (Activation gates 3) says "After 5c merges: set `CLAUDE_FIXER_ENABLED=true` (or delete the variable)" — but the plan has no checklist, runbook entry, or operator reminder mechanism that ensures this operator action is actually performed after Phase 5c merges.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- Requirement: "Phase 7 (Unblock judge) subsumes the security-pass bypass paths (P:5053, P:5290, P:5334)"
  Expected change site: Phase 7 (Unblock judge) implementation; "Subsumes" list
  Evidence of absence: The plan references "P:5053, P:5290, P:5334" as concrete code paths the unblock judge will subsume, but these identifiers are not present anywhere else in the plan (no issue bodies, no `git grep` source). The plan does not specify whether these are existing issue IDs the implementer should look up, or placeholders.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- Requirement: "Phase 7 ... `ai:operator-step` issue writer shared with Phase 8c" (referenced under Files & Modules Phase 8c)
  Expected change site: A shared `scripts/operator_step_issue_writer.py` (or equivalent) used by both Phase 7's `unblock_judge.sh` and Phase 8c's `activation_verify.sh`
  Evidence of absence: The plan describes the `ai:operator-step` issue writer under Phase 7 (step 2) and again under Phase 8c ("the `ai:operator-step` issue writer shared with Phase 7"), but neither the Phase 7 nor Phase 8c Implementation Steps enumerate the shared helper file.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
- HARDENING_SUGGESTION
  File: docs/plans/replace-claude-sessions-with-cli-engine-plan.md
  Location: Phase 1 teardown step 1 (line ~660), PR closure loop
  Issue: The plan's PR-closure step prints "Closed: the Claude session automation is retired, see docs/plans/replace-claude-sessions-with-cli-engine-plan.md" on every closed PR. A consumer that syncs Phase 1 in isolation (D1) would close a PR with a comment referencing a plan file that does not exist on their default branch.
  Suggested minimal fix: When emitting the closure comment, include the full `https://github.com/shubhodeep1/coding-workflows/blob/main/docs/plans/replace-claude-sessions-with-cli-engine-plan.md` URL (the file lands before Phase 1's PR merges, so this is always reachable), instead of the repo-relative path.
  HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
